items.title: John Levy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When I first went to Capitol Records with Nancy Wilson, [there were] the same promotional people for the Beatles, for Frank Sinatra, for Peggy Lee...

ctx.x: Even more so than in the past?

Yeah. This is what I’m saying. When I first went to Capitol Records with Nancy Wilson, [there were] the same promotional people for the Beatles, for Frank Sinatra, for Peggy Lee, and anybody else at Capitol Records. [They] had people at the head of the promotional department and worked in different divisions. In other words, one worked the Midwest, the South, and the East. But it had nothing to do with their color or their race or anything like that, or the material even. All of this started later with what was…
